SourceString: On hit, bullets <kw id="Split">split</kw> in two at 60% damage.
Bullets <kw id="Ricochet">bounce</kw> to a new target up to 2 times.
Bullets steer toward the nearest enemy.
Bullets <kw id="Orbit">circle</kw> you for 2 s, then fly at the boss or nearest enemy.
Bullets turn back to you, hitting again on the way.
Each kill fires a free extra <kw id="Volley">volley</kw>.
At the end of its flight, a bullet becomes a short wave.
Impacts leave a <kw id="Field">damage zone</kw> for 1 s.
At the end of its flight, a bullet bursts into 6.
Heals you for 3% of this weapon's damage.
Every hit applies your <kw id="Patron">Patron</kw>'s element.
DevNotes: Offer-card line. Modifier #20. Patron = World.Patron (the Keeper chosen at the Shrine).
Modifier #21 (v0.2, Outfall; Docs/Design/act2_text.md §10). Tag Mod.Backwash. Unlocked by the Discovery Bottom Feeders (DredgeSurfaced50).

SourceString: Hits <kw id="Pull">pull</kw> enemies toward where the shot came from.
DevNotes: Offer-card line. Modifier #21. Pull = a short tug back along the shot (toward the muzzle or the last bounce).
Modifier #22 (v0.2, Outfall; Docs/Design/act2_text.md §10). Tag Mod.Spillover. Unlocked by the Discovery Low Water (OutfallWin).

SourceString: On a kill, <kw id="Overkill">overkill</kw> damage jumps to the nearest enemy.
DevNotes: Offer-card line. Modifier #22. Overkill = the part of the killing hit the enemy had no HP left for.
Modifier #23 (v0.3, Sump; Docs/Design/act3_text.md). Tag Mod.Refit. Unlocked by the Sump win (D-17).

SourceString: Once a minute, a kill by this weapon drops a random modifier. Needs 3 modifiers fitted.
DevNotes: Offer-card line (<= 90 chars). Modifier #23. The pickup sockets into the first weapon with a free socket.
